{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# The population is ALL orders in the dataset, as per the contract
# So we must include refunded orders in the denominator, but not in the numerator
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total number of orders)

# Compute conversion rate by channel: converted / total
channel_counts = df_clean.groupby('channel').size()  # total orders per channel
channel_converted = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].sum()  # converted orders per channel

# Compute conversion rates
df_rates = pd.DataFrame({
    'total_orders': channel_counts,
    'converted': channel_converted,
    'conversion_rate': channel_converted / channel_counts
})

# Extract rates
email_rate = df_rates.loc['email', 'conversion_rate']
paid_search_rate = df_rates.loc['paid_search', 'conversion_rate']
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print the values explicitly
print("total_orders_email:", df_rates.loc['email', 'total_orders'])
print("converted_email:", df_rates.loc['email', 'converted'])
print("conversion_rate_email:", email_rate)

print("total_orders_paid_search:", df_rates.loc['paid_search', 'total_orders'])
print("converted_paid_search:", df_rates.loc['paid_search', 'converted'])
print("conversion_rate_paid_search:", paid_search_rate)

print("difference:", difference)

# Round for reporting
rounded_difference = round(difference, 4)
print("rounded_difference:", rounded_difference)"}
